chunks: ʿAbdullāh ibn Sulaymān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man whom a nosebleed overtakes during salat (prayer), and he does no more than sniff it back; is that permissible?

key_terms.يَسْتَنْشِفَهُ: to sniff it back through the nose

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to continue salat (prayer) if a nosebleed occurs and one only sniffs it back?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who experiences a nosebleed during salat (prayer). It indicates that if he only sniffs it back and does not do more than that, it is permissible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1053 - Abdullah ibn Sulayman asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
about a person who experiences nosebleed during prayer and is only able to stop it by sniffing. Is this permissible?
